text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Yes... yes, understood! Please<n>connect the live
feeds from all of the<n>stages.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, it's a resounding success<n>across the entire
venue. Part two is<n>just about to start, and with it...

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: It's time for "Girls' Legend U."
choice_data_list: ...The moment we've all been waiting for, huh.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Yes, the performance will take place<n>not only here
at stage A, but also at<n>stages B and C... all stages
at the<n>same time.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Every performer across the event will<n>be singing at
the same time, and<n>every fan will be cheering along.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. The technicians put a lot of<n>hard work into
this, so I'm certain it'll<n>be a fun time.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: For the girls, the fans... and you!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Wow, look at that! It's so pretty with<n>everyone
waving their lightsticks<n>back and forth.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Wow, look at that! It's so pretty with<n>everyone
waving their lightsticks<n>back and forth.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
There's green and blue, and pink and<n>yellow too...
So many lights all shining<n>together—like a field of
flowers.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... Each of us here today is a top<n>star in
someone's eyes. I have a<n>feeling it'll be a beautiful
night.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Whether it's springtime or summer or<n>autumn or
winter, burn with hope and<n>ambition...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ...And run.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Heh, this song's funny, isn't it? In<n>the end, it
somehow comes back to<n>running.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
What else would you expect from a<n>song about us?
I think the lyrics<n>turned out great!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: All right! Deep breaths...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Here we go, everyone! Let's make<n>sure our song
and emotions are<n>heard!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Woo.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
You will gain power from this<n>performance, I'm
sure of it! Now go<n>expand your potential, strengthen
the<n>utility of your bonds, and overcome<n>your limits!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Hehe. That goes for you too, you<n>know.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
We can't end it here—we're just<n>getting started!
C'mon, let's sing<n>"Girls' Legend U" together!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Now all that's left is to let "Girls'<n>Legend U" play.
